events.title: Adobe Puts Photoshop, Firefly, and Acrobat Inside Slack
events.summary: Adobe has integrated over 70 of its Creative Cloud and productivity tools, including Photoshop, Firefly, and Acrobat, directly into Slack. This allows Slackbot to use AI to direct user requests to the appropriate Adobe tool and leverage Slack conversation context for more relevant content creation. The integration, which uses Slack's Model Context Protocol, provides Adobe with distribution to Slack's enterprise users and deepens Slack's value proposition.

events.title: Adobe is making its tools available in Slack
events.summary: Adobe has integrated its suite of creative tools, including Firefly and Photoshop, directly into Slack through Slackbot and the Adobe for Slack MCP app. This integration allows users to access and utilize over 70 Adobe tools within their Slack conversations, streamlining workflows by enabling tasks like generating PDFs, editing images, and accessing Creative Cloud assets without leaving the chat environment. This move reflects a broader trend of creative and productivity tool providers making their functionalities available in conversational platforms like Slack, ChatGPT, and Claude to meet user demand for seamless, context-aware workflows.

events.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
events.summary: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an India-based marketing intelligence startup, in a deal that includes licensing and the acquisition of its six-member team. Rilo's technology, which focuses on automating marketing workflows, is expected to enhance Adobe's existing products, particularly for larger customers. This marks Adobe's second acquisition from India, following Rephrase.ai in 2023, as the company continues to bolster its AI-powered marketing capabilities.

events.title: RBC Capital raises Adobe stock price target to $315 on valuation
events.summary: RBC Capital has increased its price target for Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ:ADBE) to $315 from $285, maintaining an Outperform rating due to valuation and peer multiple expansion. The firm anticipates in-line results for Adobe's upcoming earnings report on September 10, 2026, with investor focus on updated pricing strategies and potential leadership changes. This positive outlook contrasts with other analyst views, including a downgrade from Morgan Stanley citing AI risks, and an upgrade from HSBC.

events.title: Kevin Hern Makes Series of Stock Transactions in Companies Including Adobe and Boeing By Investing.com
events.summary: Representative Kevin Hern has engaged in a series of stock transactions, including selling partial stakes in Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ: ADBE) and Boeing Company (NYSE: BA), as well as shares in other companies like Alcon, Anheuser-Busch Inbev, and Biogen. These transactions were held across the Hern Family Foundation, Hern Family Revocable Trust, and his Traditional IRA. Additionally, Hern made a significant purchase in a Canadian County Oklahoma Educational Facilities Authority bond.

events.title: How Wide Is the Range of Possibilities for Adobe Stock?
events.summary: The article discusses the wide range of potential outcomes for Adobe (ADBE) stock over the next year, with the options market pricing in a possible swing from a 39% drop to a 61% climb. This uncertainty is attributed to Adobe's strategic shift to a freemium model, its associated impact on short-term revenue growth, and a significant leadership transition. The authors advise shareholders to focus on disciplined asset allocation rather than predicting the stock's direction, given its high volatility.

events.title: Adobe Acquires Peak XV-Backed AI Martech Startup Rilo
events.summary: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an AI martech startup backed by Peak XV Partners, for an undisclosed amount, marking Adobe's second acquisition of an Indian startup. Rilo, founded in 2025, developed AI tools for marketing and go-to-market teams to build and execute complex workflows through AI agents. Post-acquisition, Rilo will cease operations, and its team will join Adobe, integrating its agentic capabilities into Adobe's enterprise suite.

events.title: Ani Pharmaceuticals SVP & CFO Stephen Carey sells $207,480 in stock
events.summary: Stephen P. Carey, SVP & CFO of ANI Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ:ANIP), sold 2,850 shares of common stock totaling $207,480 on August 31, 2026. This transaction was executed under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Despite strong Q2 2026 earnings, the company reduced its full-year guidance for Cortrophin due to underperformance.

events.title: Adobe Poised for Solid Third Quarter as ARR Seen Topping Views, RBC Says
events.summary: RBC analysts anticipate a strong fiscal third quarter for Adobe (ADBE), with Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) expected to surpass projections. The company's performance is likely to indicate continued growth in its subscription-based services. Further details are available to premium subscribers of MT Newswires.
